Tapping the castle center → city-picked-name shows exactly 'Castello / Fortezza' (iter22_city_picked.jpg); city-back returns. critical_code_review_comments: app/domain/sentinels.py: 12-slot model (INNER cardinals + OUTER all 8) with ring_for defaulting cardinals to INNER and diagonals always OUTER is correctly enforced both in start_build and in the pytest geometry tests.

natural_directions correctly checks water (grid[y,x]==3) OR off-map (returns eligible=False for OUTER when advanced_perimeter research is missing) and correctly excludes mountains (grid==2). sync_natural_boundaries claims tiles with source NATURAL:<sid>:<ring>:<dir>, matching Bible §14.

start_build returns ApiError('NATURAL_BOUNDARY', 409) when the slot tile is water or off-map instead of trying to charge resources — good defensive path; also calls sync_natural_boundaries before the 409 so the sector is claimed even if the client requested a tower.

Frontend /sentinels correctly disables INNER buttons when ring:INNER + direction is taken and OUTER buttons when ring:OUTER + direction is taken (independent keys 'INNER:N' vs 'OUTER:N'), and the localized Città queue label transforms SENTINEL:OUTER:SE → 'Sentinelle SE · r5' (not the raw target string).
